name: Sarah Knafo - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on European technological sovereignty and digital infrastructure
part_text:
Europe depends heavily on outside countries for its digital technology — most of its cloud services, computer chips and AI come from elsewhere. This report is not a law. It is the European Parliament's list of requests to the European Commission. It asks for a plan to find and reduce these dependencies, more European public digital infrastructure, a new law on cloud and AI, a revised chips law, better protection for undersea cables, and less red tape for companies.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the Commission to propose new laws and funding.
- **Who it affects:** European companies, public services, internet and phone networks, and citizens' data.
- **What happens next:** The Commission decides whether to act on these requests.
